description: Set or remove values of Amazon product type fields on ONE product, model or category (name exactly one id) — the attributes Amazon requires that are not product facts the shop shows on its site or other channels (Reparto, Tipo di chiusura, Capacità). A category's value is the default of every product in it, a model's is shared by every colour and size, a product's overrides both. Keys and values come from get_amazon_fields: for a choice, one of its values (or labels); a number as digits; a measure with a unit it lists. An attribute made of several values is set part by part under attribute.part (shirt_size.size_system): a part's value must be on its list, and one answer on the model serves every article; the CRM builds a size from each article's own size, so only a part it reported as unresolved needs an answer. Every value is checked against Amazon's schema first, and the whole call is refused, naming the fields, when a key is not one a person fills or a value cannot be taken. Write only what the user stated or what the product's facts (get_product) establish, in the marketplace's language. Saved in the CRM only: a new listing carries them; an existing offer is not changed. null removes a value, so the level below shows through again. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

categoryId.description: Set the values on this CATEGORY — the default for every product in it.

modelId.description: Set the values on this MODEL — shared by every colour and size of it.

productId.description: Set the values on this one PRODUCT (article).

values.description: The fields to set or remove, by Amazon attribute key. A value replaces what this level held; null removes it, so the model's or the category's value shows through again.

key.description: The marketplace's attribute key (closure, department, number_of_compartments), or attribute.part for one part of an attribute made of several values (shirt_size.size_system) — get_amazon_fields lists them.

unit.description: For a measurement, the unit as the marketplace names it (liters, centimeters, kilograms) — one of the units get_amazon_fields lists for the field.

value.description: The value as a person writes it, in the marketplace's language: for a field with a list, one of its values or labels; a number as digits. null removes the value at this level.

name: set_amazon_field_values
title: Set Amazon field values
